findings: Stage 13 must repair teacher-turn accounting and every dependent budget/replay constant. The declared unit counts each emitted machine control action as one teacher turn, but each of the four nonverbal demonstrations explicitly emits REPLAY_TURN, SHOW_OPTIONS, and SHOW_CORRECT_OPTION (12 actions total), while base_path_breakdown counts only four demonstration replays plus four feedback actions (8 turns). Therefore the frozen base path is 94 turns rather than 90 under its own rule, and base_teacher_turn_count, replay_scope, release-budget reasoning, and terminal accounting are not deterministic until the missing SHOW_OPTIONS actions are counted or the emission/accounting contract is explicitly changed and all dependent values are recomputed.
